notes: No accepted C++ was collected (one TLE), and the only other public solution found covers subtasks 1-3, so orig.cpp is crackersamdjam's accepted DMOJ solution (github.com/crackersamdjam/DMOJ-Solutions, CCO/cco20p3.cpp, MIT License; its author's CCO 2020 write-up describes the approach: at most one mountainous trail is used, then tree DP with binary lifting). Checked on the statement sample and on 300 random cases with N <= 10 against an independent Floyd-Warshall plus Held-Karp brute force; --max (N = 500000, M = 2000000) runs in about 6 s.
